name: ojalgo
description: Write correct, fast optimisation models (LP, QP, MIP), linear algebra (equation systems, least squares, decompositions) and portfolio optimisation (Markowitz, Black-Litterman) in Java, Kotlin, Scala or any other JVM language with ojAlgo.

licence_key.title: Optimatika licence key (optional)
